why: No canonical page covers a reusable cross-organizational co-design and iterative research process for improving educational products, and open candidate B states the same general collaborative development idea.

This is a domain-specific, collaborative and iterative user-centered product-development process that reviews and evaluates edtech features against learner variability, fitting the broader User-Centered Design for Learning principle.

This is a setting-specific school trial combining grade abolition, competency grids, learning-development meetings, and formative feedback for elementary learners rather than a standalone reusable instructional element.
This is a named dynamic-assessment instrument and task set, not a general instructional element; the LPAD mediation tasks and RCPM are assessment components rather than reusable pedagogy.
name: Cognitive Modifiability Battery (CMB)
product_description: The Cognitive Modifiability Battery is a dynamic assessment battery using mediated problem-solving tasks, including LPAD variations and Raven-type matrices, to evaluate learners' cognitive modifiability and learning potential.
